# Price-per-unit comparison

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/unit-price/

Compare two products by price per gram, kilogram, millilitre, litre, metre or count, including a chosen discount.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Compare a 750 g pack costing 240 with a 1 kg pack costing 300.

## Limits and checks

Compare like quantities in the same currency and measurement family. Quality, delivery fees and product suitability are separate decisions.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
